title: CultureSynth: A Hierarchical Taxonomy-Guided and Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Cultural Question-Answer Synthesis

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to culturally specific, RAG-synthesized question-answer pairs spanning 12 primary cultural topics and multiple regions, using LLM-as-a-judge pairwise comparisons to measure cultural competence and geographic disparities.

Measuring and comparing model performance (net win rates) on cultural question-answering tasks across 7 diverse languages (Arabic, Chinese, French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Spanish) to identify multilingual performance gaps.
